- When sentiment is strongly positive (≥0.7) in recent days, model tends to overestimate prices; reduce forecast slightly.
- When sentiment is strongly negative (≤-0.3), model often underestimates; adjust upward to reflect risk-off bias.
- Model frequently overshoots after sharp price spikes (e.g., +10%+ in 3-5 days); apply dampening factor to subsequent days.
- Mean reversion bias: if price drops >5% from recent peak, model often fails to correct; add 1-2 day lagged mean reversion adjustment.
- Forecast horizon 30d: model tends to overreact to short-term sentiment swings; smooth out extremes with 7-day moving average filter.
- If sentiment history shows repeated “reversal” patterns (e.g., +0.5 → -0.3 → +0.4), model misreads momentum; use sentiment-weighted moving average for correction.
